errors.text_span: етикетите са изписани за последователни тримесечия и са завъртени вертикално
errors.evidence: The description claims that the x-axis labels are for consecutive quarters and are rotated vertically. In the figure, the labels are for non-consecutive time points (e.g., 2003Q1, 2004Q2, 2005Q3) and are oriented horizontally.
The description states that a short-term increase reaches a peak of 190-200 around 2021Q3. The figure shows this peak occurs around 2020Q3, not 2021Q3.
